title: US strikes on Iranian nuclear sites as part of a hidden timeline war among entities

tellings.quote: meta question of if, you know, is our earthly conflict, you know, Trump just took out, you know, uh, three, uh, Iranian nuclear sites with with, you know, some B2s. Is all of that existing, you know, against some subrosa backdrop of like some timeline adjustment conflict or

plain: Michels wonders aloud whether the 2025 US strike on three Iranian nuclear sites, ordered by Donald Trump and carried out with B-2 bombers, might be playing out against a hidden backdrop: a conflict among unseen beings over adjusting the timeline. He puts it as a question to a neuroscientist named Andrew Gallimore, not as something he has a source for.
